title: Sea-Spray Wave Wash
description: A full-spectrum white-noise riser that breathes like an ocean wave — a slow filter surge rises from 180 Hz to 7 kHz with a resonance peak, while a counter-sweep on HPF pulls the bottom back out; LFOs on mutually-prime periods (8, 13, 17, 24, 32 cycles) keep the pan drift, resonance shimmer, and wet tail constantly shifting so the wash never sits still. A faint pink-noise sub-blend adds warmth and body at low gain.
